name: Avatar of Wardens
description:
You gain +0.5 step height and can sense enemies via their vibrations, causing you to anger. Once fully angered, you gain the following effects:

  • +1♥️ attack damage and +10% speed
  • Right click periodically to release a 5♥️ sonic boom
  • Shift punch the block below you to burrow, healing 2♥️ and calming your anger
